missingness_rule: A missing final predecessor charge, first provider charge, acceptance receipt or workload observation remains missing. Do not infer cessation, zero cost, full coverage or duplicate service from absence.
financial_boundary: Internal predecessor/client/provider charges are not external full-system expenditure; eliminate matched internal pairs once, include DOS and client retained work, and reconcile separate fiscal/client/fund perimeters. No savings designation before FINANCIALLY_VALIDATED.
approval_required: Competent authority and accepted accountable client/provider owners
Purpose-bound fields and stable token/linkage method
Actual cutover and complete service population including exclusions
Comparable observation periods and posting-lag treatment
Collection burden, handling, retention and public-derivative review
Prospective service quality, timeliness, readiness and stop rules
proposed_custodian_roles: RSCE controller and selected service-line lead
Selected client finance/service manager with delegated-authority custody
KJSO closeout custodian and DOS receiving payroll/service custodian where applicable

handling.identifiers: Pseudonymous organizational/service-event keys only; actual tokens, records and re-identification maps remain outside public Git.
handling.excluded: No personal names, email, bank details, payroll person identifiers or security-sensitive narratives.
handling.public_derivative: Only reviewed non-identifying aggregates and opaque source receipts after approval; an unsent contract is not collection permission.
